The house of Israel has fallen,
and it will no longer rise again.
Virgo Israël projecta est in terram suam,
The virgin of Israel has been thrown onto her land,
there is no one who can raise her up.
For thus says the Lord God:
In the city from which a thousand departed,
relinquentur in ea centum; et de qua egrediebantur centum,
a hundred will remain, and in that from which a hundred departed,
relinquentur in ea decem in domo Israël.
ten will remain, in the house of Israel.
Quia hæc dicit Dominus domui Israël:
For thus says the Lord to the house of Israel:
But do not be willing to seek Bethel,
and do not be willing to enter Gilgal,
and you will not cross into Beer-sheba.
For Gilgal will be led into captivity,
et vivite (ne forte comburatur ut ignis domus Joseph,
Otherwise, the house of Joseph may be destroyed with fire,
et non erit qui extinguat Bethel:
and there will be no one who can extinguish Bethel.
and you abandon justice on earth.
The Maker of Arcturus and Orion,
et convertentem in mane tenebras, et diem in noctem mutantem;
who turns darkness into daybreak and who changes day into night;
qui vocat aquas maris, et effundit eas super faciem terræ;
who calls forth the waters of the sea and who pours them out over the face of the earth:
It is he who smiles destruction on the healthy,
and who brings pillaging upon the powerful.
They held hatred for the one who corrects at the gate,
and they have abhorred the one who speaks perfectly.
pro eo quod diripiebatis pauperem, et prædam electam tollebatis ab eo,
on his behalf, because you have torn apart the poor and stolen choice prey from him:
domos quadro lapide ædificabitis, et non habitabitis in eis;
you will build houses with square stones and you will not dwell in them;
you will plant the most delightful vineyards,
and you will not drink wine from them.
For I know your many wicked deeds
and the strength of your sins,
and depriving the poor at the gate.
Ideo prudens in tempore illo tacebit,
Therefore, the prudent will be silent at that time,
for it is an evil time.
et erit Dominus Deus exercituum vobiscum,
And the Lord God of hosts will be with you,
and establish judgment at the gate.
si forte misereatur Dominus Deus exercituum reliquiis Joseph.
Perhaps then the Lord God of hosts may have mercy on the remnant of Joseph.
Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus exercituum,
Therefore, thus says the Lord God of hosts,
In all the streets, there will be wailing.
et in cunctis quæ foris sunt,

Et in omnibus vineis erit planctus,
And in all the vineyards there will be wailing.
For I will cross through your midst,
Woe to those who desire the day of the Lord.
The day of the Lord is this:
Quomodo si fugiat vir a facie leonis,
It is as if a man flees from the face of a lion,
only to have a bear meet him;
et innitatur manu sua super parietem,
he enters a house and leans with his hand against the wall,
only to have a snake bite him.
Numquid non tenebræ dies Domini, et non lux;
Will not the day of the Lord be darkness and not light,
et caligo, et non splendor in ea?
and gloom with no brightness in it?
et non capiam odorem cœtuum vestrorum.
and I will not accept the odor from your gatherings.
For if you offer me holocausts
et vota pinguium vestrorum non respiciam.
and I will not look upon the vows of your fatness.
Aufer a me tumultum carminum tuorum;
Take away from me the tumult of your songs,
et cantica lyræ tuæ non audiam.
and I will not listen to the canticles of your lyre.
And judgment will be revealed like water,
and justice like a mighty torrent.
Numquid hostias et sacrificium obtulistis mihi in deserto quadraginta annis,
Was it you who offered victims and sacrifices to me in the desert for forty years,
And you carried a tabernacle for your Moloch
and the image of your idols:
Et migrare vos faciam trans Damascum,
And I will cause you to go into captivity across Damascus,
The God of hosts is his name.
